VanZandtVS
body:
>Does control go away after time?

No, control of an area doesn't revert with time, though I believe if the player that owns the territory is permanently banned from the game or deletes their character all areas they held become unclaimed 

>Also are the control rewards correct? Like 10 orns a month? That's really just 10 a month? Seems so low why would people care to control?

Pvp territory control used to be one of the main ways you got yourself on the leaderboards.  Then the #1 ranked player at the time, Kliktu, cyberstalked another player and showed up at his place of employment over some "stolen" territories.  Shortly thereafter territory control started contributing basically nothing to global rank.

Nowadays pvp territory control is just something to do for loot.  If you live in an area with active players you take territories from each other back and forth as you're able and you can get some nice loot.

author: Videojamm
body:
The rewards have always been garbage, you get more from trading a spot back and forth with people in your area. 

Mostly controlling spots is just bragging rights though.

author: Drunkturtle7
body: 10 orns a month looks small but you can get permanent ones from exploration, and if you're in zone where no one plays you can keep them until someone else takes it. Over all I got like 12k orns and around 30 materials each day from exploration+territories. So it is well worth it.
